attributes.action: Andy Burnham to ensure Jack and Ash are the new Love Island hosts!
attributes.additional_details:
Love Island has given us enough “Can I pull you for a chat?” to last a lifetime. It’s time to pull Ash Holme and Jack Remington for an Amazing hosting contract.

We want their banter, chemistry and willingness to ask what everyone at home is shouting at the telly. When someone says “my head’s scrambled”, we need hosts who can investigate whether there was anything in there to begin with.

Nobody’s asking Andy B to appear in Casa Amor. Just help Britain make one good coupling decision.

Thank GAD
attributes.background: Call on the UK Government to urge ITV to appoint Ash Holme and Jack Remington as the new hosts of Love Island, bringing their humour, chemistry and AMAZINN Tom foolery to the show.
